title: Social Media Virality
scenario: Find users who had a higher follower growth rate than their previous month's growth.
tableSchema: metrics (user_id INT, mon INT, followers INT)
hint: Calculate monthly delta, then compare with LAG(delta).
correctQuery: SELECT user_id, mon FROM (SELECT user_id, mon, (followers - LAG(followers) OVER(PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY mon)) as delta, LAG(followers - LAG(followers) OVER(PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY mon)) OVER(PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY mon) as prev_delta FROM metrics) t WHERE delta > prev_delta;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE metrics (user_id INT, mon INT, followers INT);
